!! IMPORTANT !!

The way you login to your portal has changed. Please read below instructions carefully.

If you have been using this platform using mobile number, follow below steps:

Enter your username or email depending on login options available on your portal. You can reset password using "forgot your password" link. If you are not aware of your username, please contact your administrator to get username.
To ensure all your existing progress with mobile number is retained, you will be asked to provide your mobile number once as part of login process.

OR

If you are a new user to the platform, please click on "Sign up now" to create new username. Skip the step to provide mobile number and continue to sign in.
